name: Adventure Cove and Wild Woodland, Culzean
description: Two play parks by the Swan Pond: Adventure Cove, an accessible playground for little ones, and Wild Woodland, an adventure play park and treetop attraction for older children in an acre of old woodland, with towers, treehouses, slides, climbing walls, a maze house and zip slides.
fee: Non-members pay to visit the country park (adult from £14, child from £8). National Trust for Scotland members get in free and park free.
